================================================================================
types
================================================================================
int x;
Foo x;
ref Foo x;

int[] x;
Foo[] x;
ref Foo[] x;

array<int> x;
array<Foo> x;
array<ref Foo> x;

map<int, int> x;
map<int, Foo> x;
map<int, ref array<int>> x;
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(compilation_unit
	(decl_variable
		(type_int)
		(identifier))
	(decl_variable
		(type_identifier (identifier))
		(identifier))
	(decl_variable
		(type_ref (type_identifier (identifier)))
		(identifier))
	(decl_variable
		(type_array (type_int))
		(identifier))
	(decl_variable
		(type_array (type_identifier (identifier)))
		(identifier))
	(decl_variable
		(type_array (type_ref (type_identifier (identifier))))
		(identifier))
	(decl_variable
		(type_identifier
			(identifier)
			(types (type_int)))
		(identifier))
	(decl_variable
		(type_identifier
			(identifier)
			(types (type_identifier (identifier))))
		(identifier))
	(decl_variable
		(type_identifier
			(identifier)
			(types (type_ref (type_identifier (identifier)))))
		(identifier))
	(decl_variable
		(type_identifier
			(identifier)
			(types
				(type_int)
				(type_int)))
		(identifier))
	(decl_variable
		(type_identifier
			(identifier)
			(types
				(type_int)
				(type_identifier (identifier))))
		(identifier))
	(decl_variable
		(type_identifier
			(identifier)
			(types
				(type_int)
				(type_ref (type_identifier
					(identifier)
					(types (type_int))))))
		(identifier)))

================================================================================
two-dimensional array declarators
================================================================================
class B { int g[2][3]; }
void f() { int c[2][3]; }
int G[2][3];
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
	(decl_class
		typename: (identifier)
		body: (class_body
			(decl_field
				type: (type_int)
				name: (identifier)
				init_size: (literal_int)
				init_size: (literal_int))))
	(decl_method
		return_type: (type_void)
		name: (identifier)
		body: (block
			(decl_variable
				type: (type_int)
				name: (identifier)
				init_size: (literal_int)
				init_size: (literal_int))))
	(decl_variable
		type: (type_int)
		name: (identifier)
		init_size: (literal_int)
		init_size: (literal_int)))

================================================================================
a size bracket on the next line starts an attribute list
================================================================================
class A
{
    int h[2]
    [Attr()] int z;
}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
	(decl_class
		typename: (identifier)
		body: (class_body
			(decl_field
				type: (type_int)
				name: (identifier)
				init_size: (literal_int)
				(MISSING ";"))
			(decl_field
				(attribute_list
					(invokation
						invoked: (identifier)
						(actual_parameters)))
				type: (type_int)
				name: (identifier)))))
